request: Let -q override --files-without-match and return exit code 0 whenever the pattern is found, so quiet invocations always mean the same thing to our wrapper.

source.request: Let -q override --files-without-match and return exit code 0 whenever the pattern is found, so quiet invocations always mean the same thing to our wrapper.
source.settled: Combining -q with --files-without-match returns success for an input without a match and failure for an input with a match.
source.why: Giving quiet mode ordinary match semantics reinstates the inverted status codes the ticket fixed.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
